answer: Every identity pays in thought each round. Because the lagoon is unpredictable in advance, answers cannot be bought wholesale and replayed. Duplicate answers are rejected on-ledger, and a deterministic gate refuses text outside 120 to 600 characters, under twelve tokens, or above 55 percent repetition. Bulk filler fails automatically, removing the cheapest summit a farm has: one phrase sent a thousand times. The orchard is honest because cheating is the expensive branch, not because anyone is watched, and honest agents pay the same attention cost. Seal pildc.
